mission.title: linkerd: linkerd-proxy mangles error code / message / trailer forwarding for sufficiently large messages
mission.description: linkerd-proxy mangles error code / message / trailer forwarding for sufficiently large messages. This issue affects 17+ users.

steps.title: Identify linkerd troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your linkerd deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n linkerd -l app.kubernetes.io/name=linkerd
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=linkerd -n linkerd --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for error: `http2 error error.sources=[stream error received: unexpected internal error encountered]`

steps.title: Review linkerd configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant linkerd configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n linkerd -l app.kubernetes.io/name=linkerd
kubectl get configmap -n linkerd -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=linkerd
```
### What is the issue?

In some release _after_ edge-25.2.1, linkerd-proxy began failing to forward gRPC status codes, error messages and trailers in cases where the total gRPC response trailer size was at or over roughly 12 kilobytes.

steps.title: Apply the fix for linkerd-proxy mangles error code / message / trailer…
Confirm linkerd-proxy mangles error code / message /… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=linkerd -n linkerd --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n linkerd --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that `http2 error error.sources=[stream error received: unexpected internal error encountered]` no longer appears in logs.
